name: Gnomeregan: instance doors Ascension leaves unlocked need no key (#6456)
contract: #6456 Ascension's CoA client data (the conquest-of-azeroth gameobject cache, AscensionDB) has these instance doors with no lock (Data1 0), so Dungeon Finder groups without the key or Lockpicking can open them. This fork locked them with a key/lockpicking lock and GO_FLAG_LOCKED, which the client enforces. Expected: each spawned door has no lock id and no GO_FLAG_LOCKED.
